title: Skip a Layer or Loop It? Learning Program-of-Layers in LLMs

layout.note: Two aligned rows separated by a thin dashed line, one per input, each with input block, the same chain of layer boxes and an output block; two dashed pseudocode boxes sit side by side beneath both rows.

lesson: Draw the same layer chain once per input and change only the route: dashed outline for a skipped layer, a green region plus a loop-back arrow for repeated layers, a snowflake on every frozen layer, and a small pseudocode box under the rows that restates each route with colour-coded comments.
